blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: 2D array — An array organised using rows and columns.
Row — The horizontal index in a 2D array.
Column — The vertical index in a 2D array.
Nested loop — A loop inside another loop.
Validation — Checking input or a move against rules before accepting it.
Game loop — The repeated structure that runs turns until the game finishes.

blocks.title: Map 1–9 into row/column
blocks.text: Integer division finds the row; MOD finds the column. The picture highlights move 8: row 2, column 1. Inside MakeMove(), check the 1–9 range before using these indexes.

blocks.title: Check the move before accessing the array
blocks.text: Reject choices outside 1–9 before calculating/using their indexes. Reject occupied squares too. Never overwrite an X or O.

blocks.title: Make the move
blocks.text: A Boolean return value tells Main whether the move succeeded.

blocks.title: Switch player only after success
blocks.text: An invalid move should leave the same player to try again.

blocks.title: Worked example · Turn move 8 into a board position
blocks.text: Convert the player's 1–9 choice into zero-based indexes. move = 8
